svg.aria-label: Two like-for-like site deliveries. At site one, a crew and an expert deliver a result and leave a toolbox of the shared tool and its records; the toolbox travels to site two, where the same kind of structure goes up and the expert is drawn dashed with a question mark. Below, the same five measures for both sites: expert hours, review, support, rework and total cost; site one recorded, site two to compare. On the right, nine separate small efforts, and the number that matters most: expert hours per customer.
svg.text: Illustration · for discussion · not to scale
Two like-for-like sites, measured the same way
Group work, each starting from scratch.
Proposal p7: if it doesn’t fall,
it won’t scale. A claim to test.
